experiment: TSA24 matched implementation search: CPU vs CUDA via ws4 gpu-run
scope: Full TSA24 model, population 64, seed 7, generations 1/10/100; one seed; CPU is a single torch device path, not a tuned multithreaded CPU-GA; short-horizon only
